final_inverse_and_scope.scope_fix: Public local-control path refuses after factory installation; proxy uses private _connect_factory deriving current thread/context and validates actual module proxy. No caller-supplied scope reaches that factory method.

source_blocker_and_resolution.prior: After install(), public connect(scope='writer') accepted an explicit label while reports claimed actual factory-thread attribution. The unexecuted09157 predecessor remains retained.
source_blocker_and_resolution.final: The public local-control entry refuses once the factory is installed. The private factory entry accepts only timeout, checks its installed actual module proxy and derives scope from the current Thread/context. The shared original connection/attestation body is preserved. A direct post-install writer-labelled call is now an explicit refusal control with unchanged counters.

C_forwarding_review.finding: The extension receives the actual loading engine's sqlite3ext API table; it does not link a separate sqlite3 library. A different API table is refused after initialization. Internal symbols are hidden and only the specific entrypoint is exported; actual Python and SQLite API image/mapping identities are separately bound.

The original file storage follows the8-byte-aligned wrapper; total szOsFile addition is range-checked. Methods are populated only up to the actual supported1/2/3 version, preserving optional NULL callbacks. All18 file methods forward the original real file, buffers, offsets, sizes, flags, return codes and output pointers; measurement wrappers preserve errno around counter/lock work.

A failed original open with non-NULL methods retains wrapped close eligibility and increments the active-file count until close. A failed open without methods stays NULL. An unsupported method version closes the original object where available, clears methods and refuses this diagnostic host. Concurrent opening count prevents ordinary unregister during admission.

A failing xWrite records requested/error-requested bytes, not an invented successful prefix size. xRead forwards original short-read buffer behavior. The finite callback fixture checks a real prefix write effect followed by failure and exact short-read zero fill, with unchanged error and errno.

Delete/access/path/random/sleep/time/dlopen/dlsym/dlclose and version2/3 callbacks receive the original VFS object and original arguments. Default-VFS registration is never selected; unknown VFS versions and unsupported required callbacks are admission failures.

Only core-provided main/WAL/main-journal filenames are translated to their associated database. Nonmatching owned filenames are attributed to other and mark coverage incomplete. Temporary/auxiliary files remain other. This is logical filename/VFS-role attribution, not a descriptor/inode or physical I/O measurement.

Registered VFS contexts and extension code stay resident through process exit, capped16contexts per admitted image. Ordinary unregister requires no active/opening files; closing an observer with live files retains the object and refuses completion. The original callback data are not freed at last xClose, avoiding a later sqlite3_close callback lifetime gap.

Twelve fixed scope/role cells each expose23 integer metrics; overflow saturates with an explicit flag. Cross-thread use, unsupported versions, outside-owned opens, attestation/identity failures and close errors prevent complete connection-scope attribution. Shared-memory and mmap callbacks forward, while mapped-consumption/physical/directory-sync bytes remain unavailable.

Python_and_integration_review.finding: A held O_NOFOLLOW descriptor binds regular owned extension bytes/metadata before loading and at scope exit. At most four8MiB extension images are admitted. Actual executable non-writable observer/API mappings must match the hashed files' device/inode; unadmitted resident or changed prior images are refused, including /proc/self/fd pathname reuse.

The exact production factory uses sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=...). Its module-local proxy intercepts only that Path/signature, preserving original timeout and returning the actual SQLite connection. Original row factory, PRAGMAs, transaction finalization and connection close stay in the unchanged factory; unrelated calls forward.

Each observed connection uses the selected nondefault URI, checks actual main database name, actual engine source ID and exactly one additional scoped main-file open. Attestation SQL/counter overhead is explicitly included in observed calls; it is not represented as zero-cost instrumentation.

Removing the single readback context wrapper and its indentation recovers the entire original reconcile method byte-for-byte, including SQL, parameters, reader bindings and inclusive age calculation. Nested ContextVar restoration uses finally. The mixed final report is sampled after observation closure, while original deadline, polling, authority and response logic stay unchanged.

Final aggregates and exported identity are deep copied. The existing lifecycle control mutates a returned report and requires the next report to retain the original12 cells and binary identity. Reports distinguish explicit local-control connections from actual factory-derived scopes.

Queue/VFS observer objects are optional with None defaults; type-only imports do not require the new observer on the disabled installed path. They have separate report fields. Existing sqlite_fsync_calls/sqlite_written_bytes remain null and full_persistence_metric_coverage remains false.
